description: 26 cases reviewed against the six-page knowledgeops-retrieval-test.pdf. See handbook-reference.md for the source text and SHA-256. Expected sources are required physical PDF pages; no live scores are included.

cases.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees receive per calendar year?
cases.criterion: 15 paid vacation days per calendar year.

cases.question: How much unused holiday time can I bring into next year?
cases.criterion: Up to five unused vacation days can carry over.

cases.question: I need to take time away to care for an ill parent. Which paid allowance covers this?
cases.criterion: Paid sick leave covers caring for an immediate family member.

cases.question: How many days per week may employees work remotely, and whose approval is required?
cases.criterion: Up to three days per week with manager approval.

cases.question: How many days each week am I allowed to do my job from home?
cases.criterion: Up to three days per week with manager approval.

cases.question: Can my supervisor ask me to come in more often while a new colleague is getting started?
cases.criterion: Yes. Managers may temporarily require additional in-office attendance for onboarding.

cases.question: What should I do if the self-service password reset portal fails?
cases.criterion: Contact the help desk.

cases.question: My computer problem has stopped me doing any work. How should I flag the ticket?
cases.criterion: Mark it high priority and include a short description of the affected device or service.

cases.question: I cannot sign in. Is borrowing a teammate's login an acceptable workaround?
cases.criterion: No. Never ask a coworker to share credentials.

cases.question: Within how many days of a purchase should an expense report normally be submitted?
cases.criterion: Normally within 30 days of purchase.

cases.question: What details should I attach when I claim back a work purchase?
cases.criterion: Business purpose, date, amount, and itemized receipt when available.

cases.question: I got a speeding ticket while travelling for work. Can the company pay me back?
cases.criterion: No. Traffic fines are not reimbursable.

cases.question: What is the annual professional-development allowance?
cases.criterion: Up to $1,000 annually for approved role/development-related learning.

cases.question: Can I save this year's unspent training budget for next year?
cases.criterion: No. Unused professional-development funds do not carry over.

cases.question: Who can explain which medical and dental coverage options I can choose?
cases.criterion: Human Resources provides enrollment details and coverage options.

cases.question: Who should receive reports of suspicious emails and unexpected multi-factor authentication prompts?
cases.criterion: Report them to the security team.

cases.question: Is it okay to put confidential work files in my own online storage account?
cases.criterion: No. Store confidential information only in approved company systems, not personal cloud accounts.

cases.question: My work laptop disappeared on the train. Should I wait until tomorrow to tell someone?
cases.criterion: No. Lost or stolen company devices must be reported immediately.
